papers.title: Bayesian transfer for offline Q-learning with multi-task Gaussian processes
papers.reason: The paper is mainly an offline reinforcement learning method, but its application to human decision-making data gives it a tangential connection to computational modelling of cognition.

papers.title: Pixels over Symbols: Sensory Realism Improves Behavioral Alignment in Models of Cognition
papers.reason: The paper centrally compares computational models of human cognition on visual working-memory and memory-dependent decision-making tasks using human behavioural alignment.

papers.title: Trail Making Tests in Extended Reality: A Critical Review with Implications for Cognitive Ageing
papers.reason: The review is substantially relevant to digital cognitive assessment of ageing and impairment using XR versions of an executive-function test, though it is not itself a multimodal classification study.

papers.title: The Clinical Profile and Bedside Clues of Anti-LGI1 Encephalitis Presenting With Isolated Cognitive Impairment: A Multicenter Retrospective Cohort Study.
papers.reason: The paper concerns clinical cognitive impairment in humans, but the title gives no specific indication of planning, working memory, attention, cognitive control, or computational assessment.
